sections.heading: Access Control
sections.text: Access to production systems and customer data is granted through role-based access control. Roles are defined per team (Engineering, Support, Finance) and mapped to the minimum permissions required for the role; all access requests require manager approval in the provisioning system before grant. Shared accounts are prohibited. Remote access to internal systems requires strong authentication over the company VPN.

sections.heading: Security Awareness Training
sections.text: All personnel must complete security-awareness training within 30 days of hire and annually thereafter. The most recent annual campaign completed on 2026-05-30 with a 100% completion rate across 84 employees, tracked in the learning management system.

sections.heading: Incident Response Plan
sections.text: Security incidents are managed by the Incident Response Team. Roles: the on-call engineer acts as first responder; the Security Lead is the Incident Commander; the CISO owns external communication and regulatory notification. Escalation path: first responder pages the Security Lead within 15 minutes of detection; the Security Lead escalates to the CISO for any incident rated High or above. Response steps: (1) detect and triage, (2) contain affected systems, (3) eradicate the cause, (4) recover service, (5) complete a post-incident review within 5 business days.

sections.heading: Incident INC-2026-014 — Phishing credential compromise
sections.text: On 2026-04-11 a support analyst entered credentials into a phishing page. Detected by impossible-travel alert within 22 minutes; session revoked and password reset (contained). Root-cause analysis: the phishing domain passed the email gateway because lookalike-domain detection was disabled for a vendor allowlist entry. Corrective actions: lookalike-domain detection re-enabled globally on 2026-04-12; vendor allowlist reduced from 41 to 9 entries; targeted phishing refresher assigned to the support team, completed 2026-04-25.
